pages.text: Arcane Gems are specially cut pieces of Radiant Quartz, modified to only glow with a specific color of light. Each gem has unique magical properties described further on their individual pages.$(br2)$(bold)Please be aware that all Arcane Gem recipes are temporary.$() Arcane Gems will not be craftable on the $(l:blocks/gemcutters_table)Gem Cutter's Table$() in the future.

The shape of an Arcane Gem is an indicator of the nature of its function.$(br2)$(bold)Asscher cut:$() Gems with an Asscher cut generally affect entities in some way.$(br2)$(bold)Oval cut:$() Gems with an Oval cut generally affect blocks or items in some way.$(br2)$(bold)Pampel cut:$() Gems with a Pampel cut have strange or difficult to categorize effects.$(br2)$(bold)Pendeloque cut:$() Gems with a Pendeloque cut generally affect fluids in some way.$(br2)$(bold)Trillion cut:$() Gems with a Trillion cut generally affect energy in some way.
